account_modes.name: Individual profile
account_modes.description: Select work roles you personally do. Individuals do not list company services.

account_modes.name: Company / Organization
account_modes.description: Select the services your organization offers. Company settings do not include work roles.

flow: Choose a category and provider identity.
Individual: select work roles, then add role kinds and qualifications.
Company / Organization: select services and complete company details; work roles are not shown in company settings.
Verification and category rollout policies are enforced by the catalog and database configuration.

catalog_safety.beauty_fashion_styling: Massage and spa listings are therapeutic and wellness services only; sexual services are prohibited.
catalog_safety.domestic_household: Inactive pending rollout. Never expose exact home addresses; an ID-checked badge requires admin approval.
catalog_safety.health_medical: Inactive pending legal and country licensing review. Do not collect or store HIV results; sensitive Needs must remain private.
catalog_safety.business_investment: Inactive pending legal review. Nipanze does not hold funds, provide investment advice, or guarantee returns.
catalog_safety.traditional_cultural: Inactive pending regulation review. Listings must not claim to cure illness or guarantee outcomes.
catalog_safety.education_training: Academic services are guidance, tutoring, mentoring, editing, and analysis only; ghost-writing/submitting work as a student is prohibited.
